name: Teen Advisory Group (Teen Tuesdays), Fremont Main Library
org: Alameda County Library, Fremont Main Library
what_you_do: You work with the teen librarians on library projects like book displays and decorating the teen area. You can earn more volunteer hours by leading events.
who_can_apply: High school students. The page says all Fremont high school students are welcome.
deadline_text: Three Tuesday shifts are listed for Oct 13 to Oct 27, 2026. The page says the group resumes August 18.
how_to_apply: Go to the volunteer portal page. Click Fill in an application. If you already volunteer through MyImpactPage.com, log in. Questions: ebuchanan@aclibrary.org.
notes: Some events in the community need extra forms. They also have a separate sign up.
